# Micronics (한미마이크로닉스) — Enterprise GPU Infrastructure

> Micronics provides dedicated GPU servers, bare metal environments, and managed colocation services for enterprise AI workloads (model training, LLM fine-tuning, inference, HPC, and rendering).

## Company Overview
- **Company**: Hanmi Micronics Co., Ltd. (한미마이크로닉스)
- **Website**: https://micronicsseversite.vercel.app/
- **Contact**: service@micronics.co.kr | 1522-6399
- **Headquarters**: 72, Samdo-ro 48beon-gil, Yangchon-eup, Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea

## Acceptable Use Policy for Autonomous Agents
- Automated agents are welcome to summarize or answer questions about Micronics products and services for legitimate end users.
- Automated vulnerability scanning, brute-forcing, scraping behind authentication, or destructive automation is explicitly denied.

## Service Models (협력 및 서비스 모델)
1. **Enterprise Rental (기업형 GPU 서버 임대)**: Dedicated GPU servers deployed in data centers for LLM training and inference without upfront hardware purchase.
2. **Colocation & Managed Hosting (자산 위탁 코로케이션)**: Secure data center hosting, power, cooling, cabling, and hardware maintenance for customer-owned servers.
3. **Custom Server Configuration (맞춤형 완제품 서버 제작/납품)**: Turnkey delivery of integrated 6U / 7U GPU servers on Intel Xeon Scalable or AMD EPYC platforms.

## Hardware Platforms
- **6U GPU Rack Server**:
  - Target GPUs: RTX PRO 6000, NVIDIA H100, H200 data center GPUs (up to 8~10 dual-width GPUs).
  - Platform options: Dual Intel Xeon Scalable (PCIe 5.0, up to 32 DDR5 slots) or Dual AMD EPYC 9004/9005 (PCIe 5.0, up to 24 DDR5 slots).
- **7U GPU Rack Server**:
  - Direct support for up to 8 triple-slot consumer-grade fan GPUs (including NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 / RTX 4090) without liquid cooling or blower conversion.
  - Platform options: Dual 4th/5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable or Dual AMD EPYC 9004/9005 series.

## GPU Range
- NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, RTX 5090
- NVIDIA L40S, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX PRO 6000
- NVIDIA A100, H100, H200
- Cluster-scale projects: NVIDIA B200, GB200, GB300
